safe room.answer: Hardened small room; count room SF + FLAG reinforced walls (concrete/steel/CMU) for a structural allowance -- ask the spec

scullery.answer: Back/prep kitchen: 2nd sink + dishwasher + counter&cabinets, sometimes a 2nd range; MEASURE like a small kitchen (counter SF, cabinet LF, fixtures)

hb.answer: Hose Bib -- exterior wall spigot (seen on J&J slab plans)

p..answer: Pitch suffix on a roof callout, rise/12 (e.g. '16/12 P.')
